productConcept.name: PHANTOM
productConcept.tagline: Track the threat. Before it finds you.
productConcept.description: Network threat intelligence platform delivering real-time adversary detection, lateral movement tracking, and zero-day alert triage for security operations teams.
productConcept.rationale: The null-signal design system — near-black #19191c background, magenta-pink #fd356e accent, VT323 pixel display font + IBM Plex Mono + JetBrains Mono terminal stack, glitch keyframes, 8px dense gutters — is a machine-readable data interface aesthetic. The terminal/CRT hardware vocabulary maps directly to cybersecurity: surveillance, server hardware, command-line operations, threat tracking dashboards. PHANTOM positions itself as the intelligence layer between raw network telemetry and adversary attribution — a tool you operate, not content you consume.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — 0.15–0.2s mechanical easing, named glitch keyframes (glitch-shift, rgb-split, data-reveal, scanline), system boot sequence. Rich motion substance → always animate.

keyDesignDecisions: VT323 88px+ uppercase as primary display — CRT pixel terminal presence, not decorative
IBM Plex Mono uppercase with 0.15em tracking as section labels — terminal prompt vocabulary ('> SECTION')
JetBrains Mono body text — developer font optimized for dark-background legibility
Zero border-radius everywhere — strict rectilinear pixel-grid shape language
1px hairline dividers rgba(172,172,175,0.12) as section separators — barely-visible data block boundaries
Magenta #fd356e appears only at interactive thresholds — CTAs, hover states, active nav, status badges
Cyan #00e5ff for secondary labels and method badges — operationally distinct from magenta
8px grid gap throughout — terminal density, pixel-grid precision
Boot sequence GSAP timeline — clip-path 4-step nav reveal → headline glitch-shift → rgb-split → body text fade
Ghost text 'SIG' outlined behind PHANTOM headline — data corruption aesthetic at 8% opacity
Ticker band magenta — scrolling threat feed as functional UX, not decorative
Live UTC clock on threats.html — reinforces 'live feed' identity
Terminal split 1fr/1px/1fr binary divider — from grid.json layoutPatterns.terminal-split
